tools.name: metricool_list_brands
tools.description: List the brands (blogs) of the Metricool account, with their blogId, name and connected networks. Use it first to find a blogId. Swagger: GET /admin/simpleProfiles.

tools.name: metricool_get_subscription
tools.description: Return the account's Metricool subscription: plan, status, brand and post limits, and usage counts. Swagger: GET /profile/subscription.

tools.name: metricool_list_calendar_posts
tools.description: List the brand's scheduled and published posts in a date range (calendar report). Swagger: GET /v2/scheduler/posts.

tools.name: metricool_get_scheduled_post
tools.description: Return one scheduled post by id: text, publication date, networks and status. Swagger: GET /v2/scheduler/posts/{id}.

tools.name: metricool_create_scheduled_post
tools.description: Create a post for the brand. DRAFT by default (draft=true saves it without publishing). Set draft=false only when the user asks to schedule it: the post then publishes at publicationDate. Swagger: POST /v2/scheduler/posts.

tools.name: metricool_delete_scheduled_post
tools.description: Delete one scheduled post by id. The post is removed from the planner and is not published. Swagger: DELETE /v2/scheduler/posts/{id}.

tools.name: metricool_list_library_posts
tools.description: List the brand's library posts (drafts and ideas), optionally filtered by brand tag ids. Swagger: GET /v2/scheduler/library/posts.

tools.name: metricool_get_library_post
tools.description: Return one library post by id. Swagger: GET /v2/scheduler/library/posts/{id}.

tools.name: metricool_list_workflow_states
tools.description: List the brand's library workflow states (for example Draft, In review, Approved). Swagger: GET /v2/scheduler/library/states.

tools.name: metricool_get_best_times
tools.description: Return the best times to publish for one network in a date range. Networks: facebook, instagram, tiktok, linkedin, youtube. Swagger: GET /v2/scheduler/besttimes/{provider}.

tools.name: metricool_get_brand_summary
tools.description: Return the brand's published-post metrics for a date range (all networks), optionally filtered by brand tag ids. Swagger: GET /v2/analytics/brand-summary/posts.

tools.name: metricool_get_metric_total
tools.description: Return one engagement metric for one network, aggregated over a date range (for example a total of impressions). Swagger: GET /v2/analytics/aggregation.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: metricool_get_subscription, metricool_list_calendar_posts, metricool_get_scheduled_post, metricool_list_library_posts, metricool_get_library_post, metricool_list_workflow_states, metricool_get_brand_summary · Public sink: metricool_get_subscription, metricool_get_scheduled_post, metricool_create_scheduled_post, metricool_delete_scheduled_post, metricool_get_library_post, metricool_get_best_times, metricool_get_brand_summary · Destructive: metricool_delete_scheduled_post.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: metricool_get_subscription, metricool_list_calendar_posts, metricool_get_scheduled_post, metricool_list_library_posts, metricool_get_library_post, metricool_list_workflow_states, metricool_get_brand_summary · Public sink: metricool_get_subscription, metricool_get_scheduled_post, metricool_create_scheduled_post, metricool_delete_scheduled_post, metricool_get_library_post, metricool_get_best_times, metricool_get_brand_summary · Destructive: metricool_delete_scheduled_post

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
